scope: Explicit experimental neighborhood backward arithmetic; operator results, no HDiT model or task-level quality evaluation.

references.mathematical: Native torch.float64 on identical already-rounded operands, excluding pre-quantization input error.
references.formula: Independent FP32 QK/dP/actual-O delta and prescribed P/dS casts, final FP64 products; not a tensor-core reduction-order emulator.
references.small: Complete small tensors, independently enumerated shifted neighborhoods and all output channels.
references.timing: Boundary/interior query and inverse key owners at recorded positions, all heads and 64 channels; not complete large-tensor norm error.
references.counterfactual_delta: ideal_delta uses the ideal FP64-derived delta rounded to FP32 before dS, with the other declared operand boundaries retained.
references.output_cast_floor: Round mathematical FP64 dQ directly to its output dtype; excludes input quantization and additional kernel arithmetic error.

methods.baseline: P_low then dS_low, delta from actual rounded O; docs/precision.md.
methods.fp32_p: P remains FP32 in dS; dS rounds once, dV still uses P_low.
methods.fp32_p_weighted_dq: Combine FP32 P through dS with the normalized weighted-key dQ correction.
methods.legacy_weighted: Explicit optional unnormalized projection control; no historical complete-policy equivalence claimed.
methods.comparators: Native arithmetic and backend dispatch; NATTEN BHSD/BHWD copies included in complete calls.

acceptance.rule: Separate per-head norm gates for each output and gradient. Directed mathematical errors remain diagnostics; prescribed-equation gates are retained unchanged.
acceptance.zero_reference: Relative error is null; absolute error and finiteness are retained.

timing_protocol.timing: Warmed complete forward plus backward; resident CUDA graph device events. Backend layout copies inside call; immutable geometry preparation separately recorded.

mathematical_limitations.scope: Complete small-tensor mathematical FP64 dK error on sharp signed-scale fixtures; heads matched to the combined variant's worst head.
mathematical_limitations.interpretation: The dQ correction does not center dK. dK retains actual rounded-O delta and low-precision dS. Agreement with those prescribed equations is separate from mathematical FP64 accuracy; no further causal diagnosis is claimed.

loaded_compiler.scope: Generated CuTe PTX headers from the selected deployed kernels; distinct from torch.version.cuda.
